name: reduce_word_and_store

name: await_status_and_return_long

name: check_status_byte_then_reset

name: poll_status_store_constant

name: wait_marker_then_store_constant

name: divide_double_mantissa_steps

name: divide_double_normalized

name: divide_double_fraction_steps

name: round_double_quotient

name: finalize_double_quotient

name: shift_double_right_sticky

name: shift_double_right_steps

name: normalize_or_shift_double

name: return_max_finite_double

name: normalize_double_with_table

name: shift_double_right_by_exponent
